description: A procedure family's new FDA 510(k), De Novo and PMA decisions from the last days (default 90), read weekly from FDA: each as a new entrant (the company's first here), a new system (a name it has not cleared before) or a line extension (more of a line it already sells), with the basis, what it means for the rep (soWhat, from their side when the company is one of their lines) and FDA's page. Optionally one company. Needs the product and company coverage add-on.

company.description: Only this company (part of its name, e.g. Stryker).

family.description: Procedure family key from coverage (e.g. knee-arthroplasty, lumbar-fusion) or a plain name.

name: new_clearances
title: New FDA clearances, read for a rep
